name: pezhwan
description: Pezhwan (پېژوان) — One Identity. Every Application. Universal Identity & Access Management SDK.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @pezhwan/shared && npm run build -w @pezhwan/crypto && npm run build -w @pezhwan/oauth && npm run build -w @pezhwan/core && npm run build -w @pezhwan/node && npm run build -w @pezhwan/express && npm run build -w @pezhwan/react && npm run build -w @pezhwan/identity-server
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test:load: npm run build && node tests/load/auth.load.js && node tests/load/mfa.load.js && node tests/load/oauth.load.js && node tests/load/register.load.js && node tests/load/refresh.load.js && node tests/load/sessions.load.js && node tests/load/audit.load.js && node tests/load/mixed.load.js && node tests/load/totp.load.js && node tests/load/key-rotation.load.js
scripts.test:coverage: npm run build && node --experimental-test-coverage --test tests/unit/*.test.ts tests/security/*.test.ts tests/failure/*.test.ts tests/interop/*.test.ts tests/integration/*.test.ts
scripts.test:root: npm run test:unit && npm run test:security-suite && npm run test:failure && npm run test:interop
scripts.setup: node scripts/install-hooks.mjs && node -e "console.log('Pezhwan setup complete. Copy .env.example to .env and fill in required values.')"
